name: What are the benefits of expanding my deck versus building a new one?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of expanding my deck versus building a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expanding an existing deck can be a more cost-effective option than building an entirely new one, as it leverages the existing structure and foundation. It typically involves less demolition and site preparation. However, a key decision factor is the condition of your current deck; if it's structurally unsound or significantly aged, a full replacement might be a better long-term investment to avoid future repair costs or safety issues. We can help assess if your existing deck is a good candidate for expansion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expanding an existing deck can be more cost-effective than building new, but its feasibility depends on the current deck's condition and structural integrity.
